record.reason: Loong uses a 3E summary/exemplar/entity memory and observe-and-act retrieval to choose translation context, improving context utilization for long documents. However, it adds reasoning overhead and is evaluated for translation quality, not latency/memory savings.
record.title: Loong: A Human-Like Long Document Translation Agent with Observe-and-Act Adaptive Context Selection
